messages: I only placed one order, but my bank statement shows two identical payments for it. Could you check whether one can be reversed?
Hi, I’m seeing two $34.99 entries for my subscription this month, even though I only signed up once. Can you help me figure this out?
Why are there two payments for one purchase on my account? I only checked out once, so I think one of them is an error.
I noticed the same $18.50 payment listed twice on my card. I haven’t made a second purchase, and I’d appreciate it if you could look into it.
I paid for my plan earlier this week, but now there are two matching withdrawals showing up. Please let me know how to get the extra one refunded.
Could someone review my latest bill? It looks like I paid for the same appointment two times, but I only booked one.
I’m confused by my statement: there are two identical charges from your store, although I bought just one item. Would you check this for me?
My account shows two payments of $12.00 for this month’s membership. I expected just one, so I’m wondering if I was billed in error.
I placed a single order yesterday, but I see two pending card transactions for the same amount. Is one of these going to disappear, or should I contact support?
Please help—my receipt is for one purchase, but my bank app lists two payments to you. I don’t want to end up paying twice for it.
I think there’s been a billing mistake. The same service fee appears two times on my statement, even though I only used the service once.
I only renewed once, but there are two matching $49 entries on my card. Can you check and arrange a refund for the extra payment?
